body:
Hi [Name],

I am testing a narrow founder-facing service: a governed AI workflow audit and internal CEO command brief. The point is to help a founder make one urgent AI workflow or strategy decision with evidence, caveats, and clear no-go boundaries.

The deliverable would be internal only: what we observed, what looks useful, what is risky, what not to automate yet, and the next safe action. No external actions are automated.

If this matches a current decision you are facing, I would like to ask whether a small paid pilot would be useful.

Best,
[Owner]
